scope: Conditional finite jet; common eighth Euler/ninth algebraic requires the written same-coefficient assembly. No all-order or smooth field.

repair.meyer_consequence: A nonsingular rational complement of rank at least5 has a positive direction. Meyer applied to Q(v)-2t^2 proves existence of a rational p perpendicular to z with norm2; the note handles t=0. This is existence, not an extracted norm2 witness or affine quintic solution.

tenth_boundary.scope: A free quintic boundary direction preserves orders seven through nine and exposes a nonzero tenth quadratic coefficient. At least one of any three distinct lambda values fails the necessary tenth condition; no exclusion of the whole selectable quintic fiber.
